facts.label: Clube do livro
facts.sub: Em um clube do livro, todos leem a mesma obra no mês e se reúnem depois para falar do que gostaram, do que não gostaram e do que aprenderam.

facts.label: Dê sua opinião
facts.sub: Use frases simples como I loved the story, I like the character e I think it is sad. Todos devem ouvir com respeito, mesmo quando pensam diferente.

pages.title: Under the yellow lights · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday evening in a cozy library in Portland. Soft yellow lights shine over a round table. Tom walks in with a book under his arm. Six people sit with cups of tea. A woman named Ivy leads the club. She welcomes him with a warm smile.
“Welcome to book club! Did you read the book?” says Ivy. “Yes! I loved the story.” says Tom. “Great. Who is your favorite character?” says Ivy.
